arxiv-2106-05459.title: Mode recovery in neural autoregressive sequence modeling
arxiv-2106-05459.creator: Ilia Kulikov, Sean Welleck, Kyunghyun Cho
arxiv-2106-05459.description: Abstract Despite its wide use, recent studies have revealed unexpected and undesirable properties of neural autoregressive sequence models trained with maximum likelihood, such as an unreasonably high affinity to short sequences after training and to infinitely long sequences at decoding time.

arxiv-2111-11069.title: Chaotic dynamics of Bose-Einstein condensate in a density-dependent gauge field
arxiv-2111-11069.creator: Lei Chen, Qizhong Zhu
arxiv-2111-11069.description: Abstract In this work we study the effect of density-dependent gauge field on the collective dynamics of a harmonically trapped Bose-Einstein condensate, beyond the linear response regime. The density-dependent gauge field, as a backaction of the condensate, can in turn affect the condensate dynamics, resulting in highly nonlinear equations of motion.

arxiv-2205-03686.title: A gentle tutorial on accelerated parameter and confidence interval estimation for hidden Markov models using Template Model Builder
arxiv-2205-03686.creator: Timothée Bacri, Geir D. Berentsen, Jan Bulla, Sondre Hølleland, [1ex] Department of Mathematics, University of Bergen, Postbox 7803, 5007 Bergen, Norway
arxiv-2205-03686.description: Abstract A very common way to estimate the parameters of a hidden Markov model (HMM) is the relatively straightforward computation of maximum likelihood (ML) estimates. For this task, most users rely on user-friendly implementation of the estimation routines via an interpreted programming language such as the statistical software environment R ( R Core Team, 2021 ) .

arxiv-2210-08843.title: Ab initio single-neutron spectroscopic overlaps in lithium isotopes
arxiv-2210-08843.creator: G. H. Sargsyan, K. D. Launey, R. M. Shaffer, S. T. Marley, N. Dudeck, A. Mercenne, T. Dytrych, J. P. Draayer
arxiv-2210-08843.description: Abstract We calculate single-neutron spectroscopic overlaps for lithium isotopes in the framework of the ab initio symmetry-adapted no-core shell model. We report the associated neutron-nucleus asymptotic normalization coefficients (ANCs) and spectroscopic factors (SFs) that are important ingredients in many reaction cross section calculations.

arxiv-2211-01610.title: Proximal Subgradient Norm Minimization of ISTA and FISTA Thanks: This work was partially supported by grant 12288201 of NSF of China.
arxiv-2211-01610.creator: Bowen Li Bin Shi Ya-xiang Yuan
arxiv-2211-01610.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Bowen Li Bin Shi Ya-xiang Yuan. For first-order smooth optimization, the research on the acceleration phenomenon has a long-time history. Until recently, the mechanism leading to acceleration was not successfully uncovered by the gradient correction term and its equivalent implicit-velocity form. Furthermore, based on the high-resolution differential equation framework with the corresponding emerging techniques, phase-space representation and Lyapunov function, the squared gradient norm of Nesterov’s accelerated gradient descent ( NAG ) method at an inverse cubic rate is discovered.

arxiv-2304-04485.title: Formulas for the visual angle metric
arxiv-2304-04485.creator: Masayo Fujimura, Rahim Kargar, Matti Vuorinen
arxiv-2304-04485.description: Abstract . We prove several new formulas for the visual angle metric of the unit disk in terms of the hyperbolic metric and apply these to prove a sharp Schwarz lemma for the visual angle metric under quasiregular mappings. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 30C62, 51M09, 51M15 † † footnotetext: File: 2304.04485.tex, printed: 2026-8-9, 0.46 1.

arxiv-2304-10242.title: Fourier Neural Operator surrogate model to predict 3D seismic waves propagation
arxiv-2304-10242.creator: Fanny Lehmann 1,2, Filippo Gatti 2, Michaël Bertin 1, and Didier Clouteau 2
arxiv-2304-10242.description: Abstract With the recent rise of neural operators, scientific machine learning offers new solutions to quantify uncertainties associated with high-fidelity numerical simulations. Traditional neural networks, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) or Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN), are restricted to the prediction of solutions in a predefined configuration.

arxiv-2309-15024.title: Synthia’s Melody: A Benchmark Framework for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Audio
arxiv-2309-15024.creator: Chia-Hsin Lin, Charles Jones, Björn W. Schuller, Harry Coppock
arxiv-2309-15024.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chia-Hsin Lin, Charles Jones, Björn W. Schuller, Harry Coppock. Despite significant advancements in deep learning for vision and natural language, unsupervised domain adaptation in audio remains relatively unexplored. We, in part, attribute this to the lack of an appropriate benchmark dataset. To address this gap, we present Synthia’s melody , a novel audio data generation framework capable of simulating an infinite variety of 4-second melodies with user-specified confounding structures characterised by musical keys, timbre, and loudness.

arxiv-2310-14740.title: The He star donor channel towards the black widow PSR J1953+1844 2023 The He star donor channel towards the black widow PSR J1953+1844 – References

arxiv-2310-14740.description: Abstract Black widows (BWs) are a type of eclipsing millisecond pulsars (MSPs) with low companion masses ( ≲ 0.05 ​ M ⊙ \lesssim 0.05\,\rm M_{\odot} ) and tight orbits ( < 1 <1 d). PSR J 1953 + 1844 1953+1844 (i.e.

arxiv-2410-05738.title: Design, Localization, Perception, and Control for GPS-Denied Autonomous Aerial Grasping and Harvesting Thanks: Manuscript received: December 6, 2023; Accepted February 5, 2024. This paper was recommended for publication by Editor Giuseppe Loianno upon evaluation of the Associate Editor and Reviewers
arxiv-2410-05738.creator: Ashish Kumar †, Laxmidhar Behera †
arxiv-2410-05738.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a comprehensive UAV system design to perform the highly complex task of off-centered aerial grasping. This task has several interdisciplinary research challenges which need to be addressed at once. The main design challenges are GPS-denied functionality, solely onboard computing, and avoiding off-the-shelf costly positioning systems.

arxiv-2412-03781.title: Scaling laws for concentration-gradient-driven electrolyte transport through a 2D membrane
arxiv-2412-03781.creator: Holly C. M. Baldock, David M. Huang
arxiv-2412-03781.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Holly C. M. Baldock, David M. Huang. Two-dimensional (2D) nanomaterials exhibit unique properties that are promising for diverse applications, including those relevant to concentration-gradient-driven transport of electrolyte solutions through porous membranes made from these materials, such as water desalination, osmotic power, and iontronics.

arxiv-2501-08936.title: Precision magnetometry at cryogenic temperatures with gaseous He 3 {}^{3}\text{He} NMR probes
arxiv-2501-08936.creator: P. Blümler, M. Fertl, H.-J. Grafe, R. Graf, W. Heil
arxiv-2501-08936.description: Abstract We report on compact, gaseous He 3 {}^{3}\text{He} NMR probes for precision magnetometry of magnetic fields B > 0.1 B>0.1 T in the temperature range from ambient temperatures down to 4 Kelvin. The gas is polarized at thermal equilibrium under pressures up to 100 bar to provide a high nuclear spin density.

arxiv-2502-14071.title: On-demand generation of entangled photons pairs in the telecom O-band from nanowire quantum dots
arxiv-2502-14071.creator: Mohammed K. Alqedra, Chiao-Tzu Huang, Edith Yeung, Wen-Hao Chang, Sofiane Haffouz, Philip J. Poole, Dan Dalacu, Ali W. Elshaari, Val Zwiller
arxiv-2502-14071.description: Abstract On-demand entangled photon pairs at telecom wavelengths are crucial for quantum communication, distributed quantum computing, and quantum-enhanced sensing and metrology. The O-band is particularly advantageous because of its minimal chromatic dispersion and transmission loss in optical fibers, making it well-suited for long-distance quantum networks.

arxiv-2502-15227.title: Peripheral Teleportation: A Rest Frame Design to Mitigate Cybersickness During Virtual Locomotion
arxiv-2502-15227.creator: \authororcid Tongyu Nie0000-0003-4186-8749, \authororcid Courtney Hutton Pospick0000-0002-4203-1513, \authororcid Ville Cantory0009-0004-5153-2020, \authororcid Danhua Zhang0000-0001-5284-211X, \authororcid Jasmine Joyce DeGuzman0009-0007-5962-145X, \authororcid Victoria Interrante0000-0002-3313-666
arxiv-2502-15227.description: Abstract Mitigating cybersickness can improve the usability of virtual reality (VR) and increase its adoption. The most widely used technique, dynamic field-of-view (FOV) restriction, mitigates cybersickness by blacking out the peripheral region of the user’s FOV. However, this approach reduces the visibility of the virtual environment.

arxiv-2503-21481.title: Stress-driven whisker formation in lithium metal batteries
arxiv-2503-21481.creator: Martin Werres, Dariusz Niedziela, Arnulf Latz, Birger Horstmann
arxiv-2503-21481.description: Abstract Lithium metal batteries are promising for next-generation high-energy-density batteries, especially when lithium is directly plated on a current collector. However, lithium whiskers can form in the early stages of electroplating. These whiskers lead to low Coulombic efficiency due to isolated lithium formation during stripping.

arxiv-2511-06865.title: Physical properties and first-principles calculations of an altermagnet candidate Cs 1-δ V 2 Te 2 O
arxiv-2511-06865.creator: Chang-Chao Liu, Jing Li, Ji-Yong Liu, Jia-Yi Lu, Hua-Xun Li, Yi Liu, Guang-Han Cao
arxiv-2511-06865.description: Abstract We report the crystal growth, structure, physical properties, and first-principles calculations of a vanadium-based oxytelluride Cs 1-δ V 2 Te 2 O. The material possesses two-dimensional V 2 O square nets sandwiched by tellurium layers, with local crystallographic symmetry satisfying the spin symmetry for a d d -wave altermagnet.

pmc-10621481.title: Relationship between disaster awareness and disaster preparedness: online survey of the community in Indonesia
pmc-10621481.creator: Arief Hargono, Kurnia Dwi Artanti, Erni Astutik, Paulus Punjung Widodo, Arti Novelia Trisnawati, Diaz Kusuma Wardani, Evi Lioni
pmc-10621481.description: Indonesia is a country that is classified as prone to disasters because of its territory that has a lot of tectonic activity and is located between the ring of fire. Given the urgency of improving people's preparedness for disasters, studies are needed to provide a comprehensive understanding of the factors associated with disasters.

pmc-11428261.title: Bioinspired, Carbohydrate-Containing Polymers Efficiently and Reversibly Sequester Heavy Metals
pmc-11428261.creator: Sungjin Jeon, Teron Haynie, Samuel Chung, Cassandra E Callmann
pmc-11428261.description: Water scarcity and heavy metal pollution are significant challenges in today’s industrialized world. Conventional heavy metal remediation methods are often inefficient and energy-intensive, and produce chemical sludge. To address these issues, we developed a bioinspired, carbohydrate-containing polymer system for efficient and selective heavy metal removal.

pmc-11522945.title: Lung Ultrasound in Neonates: A Narrative Review Along With Diagnostic Insights and Early Postnatal Applications
pmc-11522945.creator: Salvatore Michele Carnazzo, Stergios Nasikas, Francesco F Comisi
pmc-11522945.description: Ultrasound (US) has become a useful, bedside, noninvasive imaging technique in diagnosing pulmonary diseases, particularly in Neonatology, due to its non-invasive nature, lack of ionizing radiation, and high-quality imaging. This study explores current methodologies, applications, and benefits of thoracic US in neonatal care, highlighting its application in assessing pleural morphology, pulmonary consolidations, and diaphragmatic function.

pmc-11963920.title: Associations of 24‐Hour Central Systolic Blood Pressure With Multiorgan Damage in Nondialysis Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease
pmc-11963920.creator: Cheng Chen, Ye Zhu, Lingling Liu, Jianting Ke, Wenjuan Yu, Qirong Song, Man Li, Ying Tang, Cheng Wang
pmc-11963920.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundMultiple target‐organ damages (TODs) in the same patient are common and further increase the risk of cardiovascular disease. However, the relationship between ambulatory central systolic blood pressure (SBP) and multiple TODs has yet to be explored.Methods and ResultsMobilO‐Graph PWA was used to monitor the participants' ambulatory blood pressure, and the presence of left ventricular hypertrophy, carotid hypertrophy, and kidney injury were used to define TOD.

pmc-12365264.title: A data centric HitL framework for conducting a systematic error analysis of NLP datasets using explainable AI
pmc-12365264.creator: Ahmed El-Sayed, Aly Nasr, Youssef Mohamed, Ahmed Alaaeldin, Mohab Ali, Omar Salah, Abdullatif Khalid, Shaimaa Lazem
pmc-12365264.description: The interest in data-centric AI has been recently growing. As opposed to model-centric AI, data-centric approaches aim at iteratively and systematically improving the data throughout the model life cycle rather than in a single pre-processing step. The merits of such an approach have not been fully explored on NLP datasets.

pmc-12432948.title: Diagnostic value of endoscopic ultrasound versus indocyanine green fluorescence imaging for sentinel and lymph node metastasis in patients with colorectal cancer
pmc-12432948.creator: Guocong Wu, Yu Huang, Meifeng He, Chenggang Ren, Zhuo Wang, Yangyang Liu, Yao Zhang, Jianyong He, Shaoshuai Liu, Zhengeng Jia
pmc-12432948.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundSentinel lymph nodes and lymph node metastases in patients with colorectal cancer (CRC) seriously affect prognosis. In order to improve the accuracy of lymph node assessment during surgery, it is crucial to explore advanced imaging techniques.

pmc-12566696.title: Tuberculosis Today: Microbial Insights, Epidemiological Trends, and the Role of Molecular Diagnostics
pmc-12566696.creator: Agata Maciejak-Jastrzębska, Grażyna Sygitowicz, Sylwia Brzezińska, Kinga Bielska, Ewa Augustynowicz-Kopeć
pmc-12566696.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, remains a global health problem. One of the characteristic features of mycobacteria is their exceptional resistance to environmental factors and their slow growth rate, both of which significantly prolong microbiological diagnostics. Due to the mortality rate and the rising prevalence of multidrug-resistant (MDR-TB) and extensively drug-resistant tuberculosis (XDR-TB), early detection and prompt initiation of treatment are extremely important.

pmc-12706919.title: An integrative review on filial responsibility expectations in older parents
pmc-12706919.creator: Leila Tagharrobi, Zahra Tagharrobi, Ahmad Delbari, Nasibeh Zanjari, Ali Khaji, Yadollah Abolfathi Momtaz
pmc-12706919.description: BackgroundOlder adults require varying degrees of care. The primary providers of care to older adults are often their adult children. Familiarity of adult children with the expectations of filial responsibility towards their older parents makes better relationship, improves the quality of care, and prevents the institutionalization of the elderly.

pmc-12842468.creator: Jian Huang, Pengfei Wu, Wenyuan Xing, Xiaojun Wang
pmc-12842468.description: Simple SummaryThe cotton bollworm (Helicoverpa armigera), a globally distributed agricultural pest, severely damages crops and, as a poikilotherm, is highly sensitive to climate change—yet the link between its susceptibility and climatic shifts remains poorly understood, hindering integrated pest management (IPM). We analyzed long-term H.

pmc-13170940.title: Approaches to Preoperative Assessment of Elderly Patients Undergoing Dental Surgical Interventions: A Systematic Review
pmc-13170940.creator: Aslan Ramazanovich Shurdumov, Artem Maksimovich Gusarov, Sergey Yuryevich Ivanov, Irina Vyacheslavovna Ivanova, Leonid Leonidovich Borozdkin, Shamsulvara Taymaskhanovich Kamilov, Alexey Mikhailovich Kuznetsov, Artem Dmitrievich Sviridenko
pmc-13170940.description: BackgroundElderly patients represent a high-risk population for surgical dental interventions due to multimorbidity, frailty, and polypharmacy. Moreover, standard preoperative assessment protocols often fail to account for geriatric syndromes. Objective: To systematize and analyze contemporary approaches and tools for comprehensive preoperative assessment of elderly patients planning surgical dental procedures.

pmc-13178342.title: A fusion model of deep learning and conventional features based on computed tomography angiography of carotid plaque for predicting the risk of acute ischemic stroke
pmc-13178342.creator: Yu Tang, Jinlin Yang, Yimiao Luo, Huiyue Chen, Deyao Long, Fajin Lv, Tianyou Luo, Weidong Fang
pmc-13178342.description: BackgroundStroke is one of the leading causes of death and disability worldwide, with carotid atherosclerosis figuring prominently in its etiology. Traditional risk assessment based on stenotic degree provides only limited predictive power, while deep learning excels at mining latent features from medical images.
